title: Rhythm Mirror · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Rhythm Mirror · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a partner and a short three-beat clap pattern. The lead claps the pattern once, then the partner repeats it. The partner reproduces the pattern in the same order. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Rhythm Mirror, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The partner reproduces the pattern in the same order.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The partner reproduces the pattern in the same order.
